register: Official 55-trophy PS5 list; cross-checked against the competition kit, November 2026
sources: PowerPyx trophy guide and launch-week walkthroughs
Output Lag trophy list and missables guide

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the remaining 54 trophies; this platinum is awarded for completing the trophy register, not for a separate challenge.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Let its story objectives carry through to the completion prompt; no optional medal is listed for this trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 1 story arc. Keep a separate manual save before Tourist Trap: launch guides report that it closes the chapter and there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Advance through the Chapter 2 story finale. The chapter completion is the trigger; the title is reproduced exactly as listed on PS5.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 finale. Before moving on, check any hourglass-marked stranger strand: the Yago race is reported as time-sensitive.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's story sequence. Use a manual save before the finale if you want a rollback point; no chapter medal is part of the requirement.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final story mission. Make a separate manual save first if you may want to revisit the decision; guides report no mission replay after completion.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run as the early Chapter 2 story opens. Follow the mission objectives to their finish; no optional score condition is listed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist when it appears in the main story. The trophy description asks for mission completion, so focus on the objective chain rather than a medal.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play from the main story. The named mission is the requirement; the source walkthrough gives the route if an objective stalls.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners story mission. Let the mission finish and return to free roam so the trophy notification has time to register.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown in the main story. The title and completion condition are the complete trigger; see the walkthrough index for mission order.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory when the story reaches it. The listed requirement is mission completion, not a particular approach or rank.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use Progress > Stats > 100% Completion as the authoritative checklist and clear every requirement shown there. The published checklist separates full-set tasks from partial collectible counts; use its totals instead of assuming every side activity is needed.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Mix stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights, and base jumps until the in-game stunt counter reaches 250. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep the counter moving if you also want A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type at least once and check the trophy counter between attempts. The activity guide groups the mini-games and pursuits; it does not require winning every one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Complete all 42 range challenges with a gold medal. The range locations guide lists the two ranges and challenge structure; replay a course to improve a medal rather than counting a silver as complete.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 listed locations. Track locations rather than total wins, and return to any venue that still lacks a victory mark.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win twenty distinct race events. Repeating the same course does not substitute for a different event; use the race list to identify unfinished routes.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal's fishing challenge and finish ahead of him. The fishing guide has the challenge route and controls; keep fishing until the result screen confirms the win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the arcade mini-games rather than merely starting it. The activity index lists the available games; play through to the end state once.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's stranger strand through its final mission. The strand guide distinguishes the finale from its opening encounter; complete the last task to register this trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's stranger strand through its final mission. Keep the strand active in your side-mission list and use its final objective marker rather than stopping after an earlier encounter.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's entire stranger strand and its concluding mission. Track the named strand separately from other strangers so its finale is not mistaken for a side activity.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight eligible stranger mission strands, checking the trophy's progress counter as each strand closes. The launch guide warns that some named character questlines have their own trophies and may not count toward this total.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Take Randy's stranger strand through its final mission. Use the stranger guide to locate the strand and confirm that you have reached its final objective before moving on.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's full stranger strand and its final mission. The strand guide lists its progression; continue until the finale is completed rather than counting an early side encounter.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Use the meditate interaction at all 18 spots. Start with the time-limited Chapter 1 prompt as a precaution.
trophies.caveat: Guides disagree on whether the balcony spot is required. Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy unlocks.

steps.text: After Down to Earth and before Tourist Trap, accept Lucia’s balcony meditation at Jason’s home.
Follow the location guide and use the meditate interaction at each remaining spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Begin Bret Vogel's hunting strand and hunt the unique animal named for its current target. Follow the strand's target deck, use the animal guide to find its range, and check the quest objective before taking the shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible-card sets, not three individual cards. Use the 100% checklist and map links to sweep one set at a time and verify each set's completion in the in-game tracker.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to register 100 distinct locations. Keep the app's location counter as the source of truth and vary destinations rather than repeating one stop.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Challenges and complete any fifty listed challenges. The launch checklist reports a larger total than the trophy asks for, so you can skip the entries you find hardest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner, reach a four-star Wanted Level, then escape until the search/heat state fully ends. Stay together through the getaway; the trophy is reported to pop after leaving the active red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner first, then rob three different shops in succession while the police pursuit remains active. If the Wanted Level clears between stores, restart the chain; allow a short delay after the third escape for the unlock.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK scanner on one hundred vehicle models. Scanning traffic as you travel builds the count naturally; the vehicle guide explains the scanner and the separate 100% model target.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Build the Combat Focus meter, then activate it while aiming at a group of five enemies and take all five down before the effect ends. Fish and precision activities are reported to help build Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet from a VCIA boarding bridge and take off; a plane parked elsewhere on the airfield may not satisfy the condition. Fly clear of the airport and keep a manual save first because the theft triggers a police response.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The launch guide interprets the description as stealing or entering a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station. Save first, reach the base, and get into the vehicle; the exact unlock trigger is description-led, so verify the trophy notification in-game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's locked rear entrance instead of forcing the door, then finish the robbery and leave without raising detection. If the alarm is triggered, reload a save and try another attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete five bank-vault robberies and escape after each. The optional bank job unlocks later in the story; use a partner for the haul and leave the active police search area until the escape registers.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Complete an armored-truck robbery and fully escape the police response. The trophy calls for both the robbery and getaway, so do not stop tracking progress at the moment the truck is opened.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal every region on the world map by travelling through it. The launch checklist tracks 52 areas; use the in-game map and regional progress screen to find the remaining blank areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Complete one illegal-operation robbery for each of the nine gangs. Mark gang names as you go, since repeating a gang's operation does not fill a missing faction slot.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The trophy is hidden and its trigger remains unconfirmed in launch reporting. Use the description as a lead: try ordering a cocktail at an Ocean Beach venue with a clear view, and check the trophy list after the interaction.
trophies.caveat: Launch guides list this among hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger; this is a clue, not a verified walkthrough.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The trigger is still unconfirmed in published launch notes. Use the description as the clue: enter a vehicle showroom, cause a collision or break-out, and check the trophy list after escaping.
trophies.caveat: The exact vehicle, showroom and escape condition remain unverified in the cited launch guides.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The launch guide identifies Kolt & Associates' alley as the Kingpin Bowling illegal operation in Chapter 2. Complete the robbery objectives, collect the listed valuables, and escape; the operation is reported to return if something is missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The hidden trigger is reported as reaching maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia. Train at a gym with your partner and check each character's stat progress; the public source describes this trigger as an expected interpretation rather than an official explanation.
trophies.caveat: Trigger described by launch guides; the trophy's official text is intentionally cryptic.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Public launch notes associate this description with the Criminal Profile action counter. Keep playing varied combat, robbery, and choice activities, then review the profile counter; the exact trigger is not officially explained in the trophy text.
trophies.caveat: The numeric target is reported by launch guides, not spelled out in the official trophy description.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method is available in the cited launch guides. Treat the wording as a clue to retry an activity or interaction after a first failure, and record which second attempt earns the unlock if discovered.
trophies.caveat: Trigger unconfirmed at launch; avoid presenting a speculative action as certain.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The trigger is unconfirmed. Launch guides mention several unexplained-event leads, including an unusual safe encounter and a UFO-related side story, but do not establish one reproducible method; investigate either lead and verify the unlock rather than assuming it works.
trophies.caveat: Multiple leads are reported, none confirmed as a consistent unlock method in the cited source.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: This hidden trophy has no confirmed trigger in the cited launch guide. The description suggests a melee attack performed from a moving vehicle; try the action in a safe area and verify the pop before treating it as solved.
trophies.caveat: A wording-based lead only; the source does not confirm the exact input or target.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Complete robbery or payday-loan work that yields marked bills, then sell those bills to contacts. The $250,000 goal is cumulative; use the money/robbery guides to find eligible jobs and a fence, and watch the counter.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 at shops around Leonida. Purchases across shop types contribute, so buy useful supplies and clothing during the normal route and check the in-game counter rather than overspending in one place.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garages from the Vice City Real Estate app when it becomes available. Story-provided safehouses are not the same as purchased garage properties; use the property guide's list and check the ownership counter.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten eligible vehicles through Scooter Bros. The app unlocks through a Chapter 2 mission; follow the vehicle guide's registration route, use distinct cars, and check that each registration appears in the counter.
